step1_about.description: AI-powered web design agency that builds, tests, certifies, and deploys professional websites for small businesses. Full freelance agency in one platform. We handle everything from intake to deployment with AI-assisted tools, human review, Lighthouse certification, and triple-host deployment.

step2_vision.target_audience: Small business owners, tradesmen, restaurants, salons, medical offices, law firms — anyone who needs a professional website fast and affordable
step2_vision.unique_selling_point: Not just another AI builder. We test every site against Google Lighthouse standards, deliver a compliance certificate, deploy to 3 independent hosts, and include human review. Agency quality at a fraction of the cost.

step3_content.about_text: PlanFlowAI was built by a developer who believes small businesses deserve agency-quality websites at fair prices. We use AI to do the heavy lifting — but every site is reviewed, tested against real Google standards, and certified before delivery. One platform replaces a designer, developer, QA tester, SEO specialist, and hosting team.

step5_design.design_notes: Dark navy background (#060B18). White cards for content sections. Teal/purple/pink gradient accents matching the PlanFlowAI logo. Playfair Display for headings, DM Sans for body. Dynamic scroll animations — fade in, slide in, staggered reveals. Dark/light mode toggle. YouTube video embed in hero showing a website being built. Interactive pricing calculator. Gallery/showroom with 6 demo site cards with filter buttons. FAQ accordions. Floating chatbot widget bottom-right. Professional, premium feel — this is the showcase site that proves what the platform can do.

step8_budget.additional_notes: This is the showcase site for PlanFlowAI itself. It must demonstrate every capability the platform offers — video hero, scroll animations, interactive pricing configurator, showroom with 6 demo sites, FAQ accordions, contact form with Calendly embed, chatbot widget, dark/light mode toggle, and full compliance certification. Build it page by page through the hybrid chain. Each page is a separate HTML file sharing a common CSS and nav. The 6 demo sites in the showroom use placeholder screenshots from Pexels. This site IS the proof that the system works.
